create_mvnc_distribution: create a MultivariateNormalFullCovariance distribution with a loc mean vector and covariance_matrix
sample_from_mvnc: sample random values from a MultivariateNormalFullCovariance distribution using its inherited sample method
compute_log_prob: compute the log probability of observations under a MultivariateNormalFullCovariance distribution
get_variance: get the variance of all one-dimensional marginals from a MultivariateNormalFullCovariance distribution
index_batched_mvnc: index into a batched MultivariateNormalFullCovariance distribution to extract a subset by batch index
